```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-2 (Patient Appointment File)
Conditions:
- Patient ID: Valid/Invalid
- Appointment Date: Future/Present/Past
Actions:
- Create Appointment File: Yes/No
Rules:
1. Patient ID: Valid, Appointment Date: Future  → Create Appointment File: Yes
2. Patient ID: Invalid, Appointment Date: Present → Create Appointment File: No
3. Patient ID: Valid, Appointment Date: Past    → Create Appointment File: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-3 (Workflow Routing to Doctors)
Conditions:
- Consultation Request Type: Consultation/Other
- Doctor Availability: Available/Unavailable
- Patient Preference: Same Doctor/Different Doctor
Actions:
- Route to Doctor: Yes/No
Rules:
1. Consultation Request Type: Consultation, Doctor Availability: Available, Patient Preference: Same Doctor → Route to Doctor: Yes
2. Consultation Request Type: Consultation, Doctor Availability: Unavailable, Patient Preference: Different Doctor → Route to Doctor: Yes
3. Consultation Request Type: Other, Doctor Availability: Available, Patient Preference: Same Doctor → Route to Doctor: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-4 (Routing to Chemist and Labs)
Conditions:
- Patient Pincode: Matches Chemist Pincode/Mismatch
- Lab Pincode: Matches Patient Pincode/Mismatch
- Request Type: Chemist/Lab/Both
Actions:
- Route to Chemist: Yes/No
- Route to Lab: Yes/No
Rules:
1. Patient Pincode: Matches Chemist Pincode, Request Type: Chemist → Route to Chemist: Yes
2. Patient Pincode: Mismatch, Request Type: Chemist → Route to Chemist: No
3. Lab Pincode: Matches Patient Pincode, Request Type: Lab → Route to Lab: Yes
4. Lab Pincode: Mismatch, Request Type: Lab → Route to Lab: No
5. Request Type: Both, Matches both Pincodes → Route to Chemist: Yes, Route to Lab: Yes

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-5 (Machine Learning Disease Prediction)
Conditions:
- Symptom Set: Matches Training Data/Partial Match/No Match
- Training Data Availability: Available/Unavailable
Actions:
- Predict Disease: Yes/No
Rules:
1. Symptom Set: Matches Training Data, Training Data Availability: Available → Predict Disease: Yes
2. Symptom Set: Partial Match, Training Data Availability: Available → Predict Disease: No
3. Symptom Set: No Match, Training Data Availability: Unavailable → Predict Disease: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-6 (Continuous Training of ML Algorithm)
Conditions:
- New Data Set Availability: Yes/No
- Algorithm Performance: Above Threshold/Below Threshold
Actions:
- Retrain Algorithm: Yes/No
Rules:
1. New Data Set Availability: Yes, Algorithm Performance: Below Threshold → Retrain Algorithm: Yes
2. New Data Set Availability: No, Algorithm Performance: Above Threshold → Retrain Algorithm: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-8 (Archiving Inactive Patients)
Conditions:
- Last Consultation Date: Within 3 Years/Age > 3 Years
Actions:
- Archive Patient: Yes/No
Rules:
1. Last Consultation Date: Age > 3 Years → Archive Patient: Yes
2. Last Consultation Date: Within 3 Years → Archive Patient: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-9 (Consultation Request Volume)
Conditions:
- Weekly Requests: <25000/25000/>25000
Actions:
- System Performance: Acceptable/Needs Optimization/Overloaded
Rules:
1. Weekly Requests: <25000 → System Performance: Acceptable
2. Weekly Requests: =25000 → System Performance: Acceptable
3. Weekly Requests: >25000 → System Performance: Needs Optimization
```
